name: [BATMOBILE] Destroy Cars with Nitro
desc:
UPDATE: 70 new stunt pieces: loops, kickers, half pipes, boost and launch pads, spinners, smashable props and more!
The map editor now works on mobile, with multi-select, undo/redo, snapping, and colour and material pickers.
New Test Drive button: try your map with real cars before you publish it.
Better map browser with sorting tabs, descriptions, upvotes in-game and faster loading.
Fixed gravity and music saving, cars no longer collide with each other, plus lots of bug fixes!

Get ready for total chaos! Blast your car across endless ramps, giant loops, and insane jumps and watch the parts fly off! Use your nitro boost to crash harder, jump higher, and cause epic destruction. How long can your car survive?

Type in chat :normal or :refresh (to refresh your character) / type yeet for a goofy moments
🎃 Stage Phase: 47%
🔨 SHUTDOWNS=UPDATES/BUG FIXES
